comparison.objective: Match leader and follower poses before enabling teleoperation, then steer around an obstacle, versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Pose matching, safe enable sequencing, and continuous leader-arm path control versus hex-key engagement, collar tuning, torque locking, and response-based cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Follower avoids the glass and reaches the green dot after safe pose matching versus two safe physical stops and a lock-drift witness test.
comparison.reason: Safe enable sequencing is shared only generically; the core ability is teleoperation path control rather than mechanical calibration. No spec versions are present, and the sparse body omits pose, clearance, target, and timing thresholds.
